q: Why does round-robin overload a heterogeneous fleet?
a: It deals equal share regardless of speed, so the slow server queues and p99 follows the slow path.
Fewest in-flight requests per backend, which adapts to slow or sick servers automatically.
When servers are identical in capacity and requests cost roughly the same.

q: What per-backend metric reveals the overload first?
a: Queue depth on the slow backend, before average latency moves much.
